name: Celeste C. Lawton
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Celeste C. Lawton is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. Celeste Lawton is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Celeste Lawton chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended Baylor University School of Law and graduated in 2001. Celeste Lawton passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2001.
She represents clients with Estate Planning & Probate issues in Texas. She also represents clients with Closely Held Business issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Celeste Lawton has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
